name: Vita Dynamics
summary: Vita Dynamics is a Beijing robotics company operating under the Vbot brand. It develops consumer robots and an embodied-intelligence operating system for homes and other everyday environments. Its portfolio spans quadruped robots and announced humanoid designs, with research teams in Beijing, Shanghai and Shenzhen. Its humanoid program is presented as a prototype development effort; the delivery history of its quadrupeds is not evidence of humanoid commercial availability.
